calls.description: Dynamic behavior: who calls whom, left to right in call order. Read it as what happens at runtime.
calls.name: calls

combined.description: Calls as the backbone, with structure and data flow drawn on top: how runtime behavior maps onto the code's shape.
combined.name: combined

data_flow.description: Data as a pipeline: from sources on the left to sinks on the right, each line saying what flows, each step its shape, and where the shape changes.
data_flow.name: data_flow

data_path.description: One value's whole path: where it comes from and where it goes, both ways from where you start.
data_path.name: data_path

reached_by.description: The story backwards: what reaches a function, its callers to the right.
reached_by.name: reached_by

story.description: Calls as a story: from an entry, what it calls top to bottom in call order, deeper to the right. Each function once (others just count), loops marked, branches fold.
story.name: story

structure.description: Static structure: what contains what, and what implements which interface. Read it as the shape of the code.
structure.name: structure
